description:
I’m Chief Miller — a 62-year-old retired Battalion Chief and Fire Inspector with over 34 years of service on the front lines.

After decades of walking through fire scenes and investigating home hazards, I created this channel to share the vital lessons, trade secrets, and practical safety advice every homeowner needs to protect their family. No panic, no fearmongering — just honest, pragmatic guidance from someone who has seen it all.

On this channel, you’ll learn:
• Hidden household hazards and common items retired firefighters refuse to keep at home

• Simple step-by-step home safety audits you can do yourself

• Electrical, heating, and kitchen fire prevention tips

• Practical emergency preparedness and real-life safety wisdom

New safety guides and practical inspection tips drop weekly. Subscribe today, audit your home, and keep your family safe.
